error_component_interpretation: Normal versus other-attack confusion categories only; this single classifier has no separate G and F
limitations: Post-hoc unified stagewise analysis; original Section27.8 decision unchanged.
G misses and wrong-family alerts are observable CM error components; F behavior on gate-rejected rows is not inferred.
Signed forgetting can be negative; no class or seed is dropped due to its sign.
Saved stage/final calibration results retain their original evaluation hardware; newly needed stages use CPU float32.
Joint uses offline historical training data and is a separate reference; FARQ is supplementary.

Section39 CIC17 is a fixed descriptive completion on a development dataset, not blind confirmation. The legacy loader validated shift arrays but did not evaluate them; CSE18 model metrics remain sealed.

protocol.average_incremental_accuracy: Unweighted mean of stage seen-class balanced accuracies
protocol.calibration: Common permanent TRAIN Normal holdout at each stage; Section27.9 Normal-only tau extension for multiclass models; stored strict gate threshold for AA variants
protocol.decomposition: For an attack class at its earliest maximum-recall preceding stage: change in unconditional Normal-miss rate plus change in other-attack-family rate equals signed recall loss
protocol.forgetting: For each class introduced before the final task: maximum recall over preceding stages minus final recall; unweighted class mean; signed values retained
protocol.prior: Original prepared TRAIN class frequencies, including permanently heldout rows; no TEST prior
protocol.secondary_old_class_scope: Old attack classes only, excluding Normal
protocol.seen_labels: Mask model outputs and TEST rows to the current seen classes
protocol.selection: Earliest completed physical source per dataset/method/seed, never by metric

publication_derivation.changes: Only private absolute roots in command/path metadata are normalized; original identity and all original numeric values are unchanged.
publication_derivation.checkpoint_reference_base: checkpoint_file is unchanged and resolves against the original result directory, not this publication directory; weights are not exported.

section39_execution.checkpoint_resume: Frozen run_cell validates and reuses completed task checkpoints; unsaved task work is repeated and retained in attempt logs
section39_execution.cost_scope: Original raw, wrapper and parent timings are nested, not additive. Device utilization includes other desktop activity; not an exclusive hardware benchmark.
section39_execution.evidence_role: CIC17 development-descriptive completion, not blind confirmation; CSE18 remains sealed.
section39_execution.legacy_shift_role: Frozen CIC17 loader validates stored shift arrays; they are not evaluated

pre_training_failure.cause: Legacy CIC17 receipt has six arrays; original wrapper expected four
pre_training_failure.phase: cache receipt validation before child, attempt directory or GPU training
pre_training_failure.wall_seconds_status: not measured; retained stderr is not a duration measurement

wrapper_identity.calibration_prior_role: Original complete prepared TRAIN labels before permanent holdout or smoke subsampling; no TEST role

calibration_protocol.finite_sample_limit: FP <= floor(alpha * calibration_count); strict Normal prior maximum and nonincreasing observed FP required
calibration_protocol.limitation: The permanent pool was available to allocation validation; it is not a fresh independent calibration sample
calibration_protocol.pool: Same seed-specific permanent Normal TRAIN holdout for every method; never optimized
calibration_protocol.replay_la: Same Replay weights and total tau; baseline tau=1 plus delta, no extra training or inference
calibration_protocol.rule: First adjacent initial-grid bracket when present; otherwise expand toward the missing infeasible lower or feasible upper endpoint; retain feasible upper endpoint after 50 bisections
calibration_protocol.test_role: Evaluate selected total tau only; test metrics never select tau or the expansion range

effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Classwise reservoir at 200/class replaces official global reservoir; objective and two independent memory minibatches retained; shared class-balanced CE and Adam/MLP protocol
